method: Gaussian residual MLE; Q=sum(alpha_i B_i) from Nav2 OmniMotionModel; known visual R included; no residual mean removal
fit_sources: own RGB slip-diagnostic measured intervals and own issued pulse profiles only
sample_rule: earliest measured interval per pulse; no outcome-based filtering; partial pulse is usable only for its explicitly measured interval
interval_model: existing S2 mean curve increment and per-pulse covariance times interval/horizon, in interval-start body frame
visual_covariance: recorded feature-fit covariance plus existing +/-2.8deg uniform common radial pitch sensitivity; not evaluated actual pitch
parameters: alpha1..5 >=0, L-BFGS-B from all 0.2, maxiter2000 ftol1e-12 gtol1e-8; no multi-start or result-based tuning
identifiability: normalized covariance design rank exactly5 and optimizer success; otherwise no fit or on replay for fold
scope: only loaded look_ahead coarse lateral profiles actually represented in fit; unloaded, forward, turn, fine, all means and thresholds unchanged
admission: unchanged consistency-criteria.json; all holdouts must pass; unavailable covariance at any primary time fails coverage gate
off_check: attach identity test plus byte-identical 300-frame acceptance against previously sealed off; historical full off20,778 frames unchanged source preserved
limitations: sparse, visually selected calibration; shared camera systematic errors persist; this is not Censi differential-drive wheel-radius/extrinsic joint calibration
